senses.gloss: (b. h. אָרַךְ)to be long, to project.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 8:8">Targ. I Kings VIII, 8</cite>; <cite ref="II Chronicles 5:9">II Chr. V, 9</cite>.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:2:3">Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᶜ</cite> top, v. <cite ref="A01342"><he>אִימָמָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 28:67">Targ. Y. Deut. XXVIII, 67</cite> <cite ref="M00066"><he>מְאַרְכַן</he></cite> make appear long; a. fr.—Y. Taan. IV, 68ᵃ <he>מְאַרְכָה יומין</he> to live long; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:7">Koh. R. to VII, 7</cite>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 109b:6">Snh. 109ᵇ</cite> <he>כי מאריך</he> when one was tall.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 6:11">Targ. Job VI, 11</cite>.—Y. Yoma VI, 43ᵈ <he>אורכין צבחר</he> wait a while. Y. R. Hash. I, 57ᵃ bot. <he>הוות מוֹרְכָה וכ׳</he> she waited a whole year.
<cite ref="Yoma 2a">Ib.</cite> <he>הוו מורכין</he>. Y. M. Kat. II, 81ᵇ top <he>אילפא מורכא לך</he> the ship will wait for thee.
